newsitem.title: UK: Venezuela stock index to hit 6,020 by yr-end - ABN.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela stock index to hit 6,020 by yr-end - ABN.

text.p: The Caracas stock index will end the year at 6,020, with further rises likely next year, ABN AMRO chief economist for Latin America, Ian Campbell said on Wednesday.
The 19-share index closed at 5,960.92 on Tuesday.
Campbell said the rise would provide a U.S. dollar return of 69.5 percent in 1996.
"We expect a rise of a further 26 percent in U.S. dollar terms next year," he said in a research note which recommended La Electricidad de Caracas, food company Mavesa and steel producer Sivesa.
"The market is responding to the turnaround in economic policy in the country, which has opened the way to privatisation and improved economic growth," he said.
If reforms go ahead, the economy will come out of recession next year and inflation will fall sharply, leading to promising medium-term growth prospects.

Privatisation of telecommunications company CANTV, due before the end of the year, will substantially increase the stock market capitalisation which will in turn encourage funds investing in Latin America to increase their allocation in Venezuela.
"Privatisations of aluminium companies and Sidor, the steel company, should give further impetus to the market in the first half of next year," he added.
